items.summary: Thomas Markle, the estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex, Meghan Markle, and father-in-law of Prince Harry, was indicted on Tuesday in U.S. federal court on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material.

items.title: ‘How to Kill a Federal Judge’ author sentenced to prison
items.summary: A U.S. judge on Tuesday sentenced a Minnesota man to six-and-a-half years in prison after he wrote and distributed a manifesto titled “How to Kill a Federal Judge.”
